scope: Polish SMEs: innovation, digital and green transformation, startup development and internationalisation.

programmes.title: Ścieżka SMART — projekty B+R
programmes.description: Research to develop innovative products or processes.
checks: Confirm genuine R&D, innovation criteria and eligible research costs.

programmes.title: Ścieżka SMART — wdrożenie wyników B+R
programmes.description: Implementation of completed R&D results in business.
checks: Confirm rights to completed R&D results and the required innovation level.

programmes.title: Pożyczki na cyfrową i zieloną transformację
programmes.description: Repayable finance for digital and environmental business transformation.
checks: Published eligible project-cost range: PLN 2.5–15 million; this is not a grant award range.
Launch planned for Q4 2026 through financial intermediaries; confirm actual availability and credit terms.

programmes.title: Startup Booster Poland — Scale Up Green
programmes.description: Accelerator support for young companies testing solutions with technology recipients, including circular business models.
checks: Micro or small startup required; SME status alone is insufficient.
Apply through an accelerator; its recruitment dates and track conditions may differ.

programmes.title: Startup Booster Poland — Smart UP
programmes.description: Acceleration and product development support for early-stage innovative businesses.
checks: Micro or small startup required; verify age, operator track and recruitment conditions.

programmes.title: Granty na Eurogranty
programmes.description: Support for preparing an application to an eligible EU programme.
checks: Funds application preparation, not the subsequent investment or research project.
Confirm the target EU programme and the applicable lump-sum category.

programmes.title: Promocja marki innowacyjnych MŚP
programmes.description: International trade-fair and mission support for innovative SME product brands.
checks: Confirm eligible sectors, trade fairs, export experience and promoted product brand.

programmes.title: STEP — Biotechnologie, ścieżka A
programmes.description: Investment in innovative critical biotechnology.
checks: The published 2026 call was cancelled; it is retained for reference only.
Confirm that the investment meets STEP critical-technology criteria.

programmes.title: STEP — Czyste technologie, ścieżka A
programmes.description: Investment in innovative critical clean and resource-efficient technologies.
checks: Developing or manufacturing a critical technology is distinct from simply buying solar panels.
Confirm STEP technology scope, innovation and investment requirements.

programmes.title: STEP — Technologie cyfrowe, ścieżka A
programmes.description: Investment in innovative critical digital technologies.
checks: Ordinary business software or factory automation does not establish STEP eligibility.
Confirm critical-technology scope and innovation requirements.

programmes.title: GOZ w MŚP — etap I: model biznesowy
programmes.description: Preparation of a circular-economy transformation business model.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
This stage finances preparation of the model, not its equipment implementation.

programmes.title: GOZ w MŚP — etap II: wdrożenie
programmes.description: Implementation of a circular-economy business transformation.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
Confirm the required GOZ model, its approval and eligible implementation costs.

programmes.title: Automatyzacja i robotyzacja w MŚP
programmes.description: Digital transformation of production or services through automation and robotics.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
A technology audit and transformation roadmap are required; verify investment and conditional-grant rules.

programmes.title: Wzornictwo w MŚP
programmes.description: Design audit, design strategy and its implementation.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
This 2026 call targets businesses meeting the women-led business criteria; verify ownership/management requirements.

programmes.title: Platformy startowe — komponent IIa
programmes.description: Development of an incubated innovative startup product and first sales.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
Micro or small capital company with completed qualifying Platform incubation and recommendation required.

programmes.title: Platformy startowe — komponent IIb
programmes.description: Further development of an innovative startup product after component IIa.
checks: Eastern Poland location required, excluding the Warsaw capital region.
Prior completion of component IIa and its final payment application must be checked.

programmes.title: Kredyt ekologiczny (BGK)
programmes.description: Grant premium linked to a bank loan for energy-saving modernisation.
checks: Energy audit and at least 30% primary-energy savings in the modernised area required.
Bank creditworthiness and qualifying modernisation required; OZE alone is not enough.

programmes.title: Kredyt technologiczny (BGK)
programmes.description: Grant premium repaying part of a bank investment loan for technology implementation.
checks: Confirm an eligible new technology, investment costs, bank creditworthiness and own contribution.
Current call dates were not verified; check BGK before planning an application.

programmes.title: EIC Accelerator
programmes.description: Support for high-risk breakthrough innovation and scaling, with grant and investment routes.
checks: Grant component below EUR 2.5 million for TRL 6–8; equity has different limits and terms.
Short proposals and full-proposal batching dates differ; check the current timetable.
Confirm breakthrough innovation, technology readiness and the relevant funding route.

programmes.title: Horizon Bridge
programmes.description: Advisory support to prepare Polish SMEs for Horizon Europe applications.
checks: Published support value up to PLN 66,000 concerns advisory services, not a cash investment grant.
Confirm programme selection requirements and the intended Horizon Europe application.
